title: Concept: Centralised dependency repositories include a cleartext endpoint
description: settings.gradle declares a `dependencyResolutionManagement` repository URL over cleartext, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: An artifact fetched over plain HTTP can be replaced in transit, so the bytes that install are not bound to what the author published. This rule reads a `dependencyResolutionManagement` repository URL over cleartext.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through settings.gradle (gradle).
risk: An artifact fetched over plain HTTP can be replaced in transit, so the bytes that install are not bound to what the author published. This rule reads a `dependencyResolutionManagement` repository URL over cleartext.
